settings.github_token.label: GitHub personal access token
settings.github_token.description: Create a classic token with the 'notifications' scope at github.com/settings/tokens and paste it here. Stored locally in Noctalia settings.
settings.poll_interval_sec.label: Polling interval (seconds)
settings.poll_interval_sec.description: How often to check GitHub for unread notifications (60-600 s). The notifications API allows ~50 requests/hour.
